itemTitle: Winsor & Newton Artists' Oil Colour Set (10 Tubes, 21ml)

messages.text: Hello Sarah! Are you still open to local exchange for the Winsor & Newton oil set? I submitted a swap request with my Velvetouch brush set.
Hi Marcus! Yes, the Velvetouch brushes look fantastic. Are they suitable for water-mixable oils too?
Yes absolutely! They are synthetic so they handle water and solvent mediums without swelling. We could meet up near the Fremont bridge this weekend.
